spans.s:
भव (वः) 1.
m. Being; birth; ob-
taining; the world; welfare;
Shiva. n. Fruit of the dillenia.

भाव (वः) 1.
m. Nature, state or con-
dition; meaning; mind; birth;
act; love; spot; thing.

भव-घस्मर (रः) 1.
m. Fire in a forest.

भवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Thou; self.
f. (न्ती) Poisoned arrow.
a. Being.

भवदीय (यः-या-यं)
n. Yours.

भव-द्भी (द्भीः-द्भिः-द्भि)
a. Afraid.

भवन (नं) 1.
n. A house; a quality.

भावन (नं-ना) 1.
n. f. Mental percep-
tion; abstract meditation; adorn-
ing the person with flowers,
perfume, &c.; infusion or steep-
ing; composition; proof.

भव-नाशिनी (नी) 3.
f. The
Serya river
which runs into the
Goggrah.

भवनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. What is or ought
to be or to become.

भवनो_दर (रं) 1.
n. A private room.

भवन्त (न्तः) 1.
m. Time; time pre-
sent.
f. (न्ती) A virtuous wife.

भवन्ति (न्तिः) 2.
m. Time being.

भव-भाज् (क्)
a. World possessing.

भव-भावन (नं) 1.
n. Cause of birth.
a.
Causing or creating the world.

भव-भूति (तिः) 2.
m. A dramatic au-
thor of some eminence.

भव-रुद् (त्) 5.
f. A funeral drum.

भव-वीति (तिः) 2.
f. Passing from
the world; end of the world.

भवा_त्म-जा (जा) 1.
f. Goddess
Manasa.

भवा-दृश् (क्)
a. Like you.

भवानी (नी) 3.
f. The goddess
Dur-
gā in her amiable form.

भवानी-गुरु (रुः) 2.
m. The personi-
fied
Himālaya mountain.

भवा_भाव (वः) 1.
m. Non-existence
of the world; a sage.

भवा_भिभाविन् (वी-विनी-वि)
a. Over-
coming the world.

भवायना (ना) 1.
f. The Ganges.

भविक (कं) 1.
n. Prosperity.
a. Pros-
perous, faring well.

भाविक (कः-का-की-कं)
a. Natural;
sentimental; future.
n. Describ-
ing past or future as present.

भवित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Been; become.

भावित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Supposed, ima-
gined; animated; possessed of;
scented; mixed; infused; ob-
tained; promised.

भवितव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. What should
be or become, what must be.

भवितव्यता (ता) 1.
f. Fate, destiny.

भवितृ (ता-त्त्री-तृ)
n. Actually being,
disposed to be, faring well.

भविन् (वी-विनी-वि)
a. Living, being.

भाविन् (वी-विनी-वि)
a. Future, about
to be.
f. A wanton woman.

भविन (नः) 1.
m. A poet, versifier.

भविल (लः) 1.
m. A catamite.
a.
Being, existing, what is to be.

भविष्णु (ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
a. Actually being
or disposed to be, being well.

भविष्य (ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
a. Future.

भविष्यत् (ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
a. Idem.

भव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. Happy; fit; true;
what is to be; a being.
m. Ka-
maranga fruit.
f. Durgā; pep-
per.
n. Bone; fruit; being.

भाव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. What will be.

भावक (कः) 1.
m. Outward expres-
sion of love or affection.

भाव-ज (जः) 1.
m. Love.

भावत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Yours, respectfully.

भावत्क (त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
a. Idem.

भाव-बोधक (कः) 1.
m. The sign or
indication of any sentiment or
passion or feeling.

भाव-शवलता (ता) 1.
f. Variety of emotions.

भाव-शान्ति (न्तिः) 3.
f. Allaying emo-
tions or feelings.

भाव-संशुद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Purification
of nature or natural qualities.

भाव-सन्धि (न्धिः) 2.
f. Union of two
emotions in the mind.

भाव-समाहित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Of sub-
dued feelings; abstracted.

भावा-ट (टः) 1.
m. Outward expres-
sion of love; a good man; a
lustful man; an actor; dress.

भावा_नुग (गः-गा-गं)
a. Natural.

भावा_भास (सः) 1.
m. Assumed emotion.

भावा_र्थ (र्थः) 1.
m. Simple meaning.

भावा_व (वः-वा-वं)
a. Tender, feeling.

भावितवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Ima-
gining; mixing, infusing.

भाविता_त्मन् (त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
a. Intent upon.

भावित्र (त्रं) 1.
n. The three worlds.

भावुक (कः-की-कं)
a. Happy, becoming
happiness.
m. Sister's husband.

भावो_दय (यः) 1.
m. Rising emotion.

भवादृश (शः-शा-शं)
a. Like you.
adv. Gravely.
